description: Long-search finder for a pasted Search Console export. Use this when the user pastes Search Console Performance rows or a CSV and asks which questions to answer on their pages, or how to get named in ChatGPT or Google AI answers. Pass the text as csv, or JSON rows as rows, with query and impressions, and page if there is one. Keeps the searches of 7 or more words (the rule ^(\S+\s){6,}\S+$), ranks them by impressions and marks which look like questions. Each has the page Google shows, the question as a heading, and a 2-sentence answer skeleton with a placeholder for one real number or fact that only the owner knows. Also groups by page. Up to 5000 rows. Reads only what is pasted: no Google login, no Search Console call, no AI engine, nothing stored. It does not write the answer and does not invent the number. Ask the question by hand in ChatGPT or Google AI before editing the page.

csv.description: Pasted text of a Search Console export: a header row, then one row per search. Needs a query column and an impressions column; a page column, clicks and position are used when present. Comma, semicolon or tab separated. Up to 5000 data rows. Do not pass this together with rows.

limit.description: Most questions to return, 1 to 50. Default 20.

rows.description: The same data as JSON rows, for example {"query": "how do I ...", "page": "https://example.com/a", "impressions": 120, "clicks": 3, "position": 8.2}. Up to 5000 rows. Do not pass this together with csv.

name: find_ai_questions

pages.description: The pages that Google shows for these searches, by total impressions.

answerSkeleton.description: Two sentences with a placeholder. The second needs a real number or fact from the owner.

heading.description: The question as a page heading: same words, first letter capital.

isQuestion.description: True when the search ends with ? or starts with a question word.

page.description: The page with the most impressions for this search. Absent when the input has no page column.

position.description: Average position, weighted by impressions. Only when the input has it.

rank.description: Position by impressions among all searches of 7 or more words.

hasPages.description: False when the input has no page column.

longQueries.description: Distinct searches of 7 or more words.

questionLike.description: Of those, how many start like a question.

rowsSkipped.description: Rows without a query, or with impressions that are not a number.

rowsUsed.description: Rows with a usable query and impressions.

title: Find the questions to answer for AI search
